messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 11:12 UTC - us-east1 ingress queue pressure causing elevated 502/504s for Hosted API. Immediate mitigation steps underway. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-21876 @channel

jessica: Oncall SRE. Observed long request hold times in the ingress proxies; request queues saturating and backpressure to upstream routers. Kicking off mitigation.

omar: Looking at request traces - a small number of clients sending long-lived streaming calls with malformed chunking. These are preventing kv-cache warm paths and creating hot tails.

li-wei: Can we apply per-tenant circuit breaker and mark those streams as low-priority? I can push a routing rule.

tanya: Support: flagged 4 customers showing majority of errors. Notifying account teams and CS, opening support tickets.

jessica: Mitigation plan: 1) add temporary per-tenant circuit breaker 2) enable regional fallback to us-west for non-SLA traffic 3) scale ingress pool + patch proxy config to reduce per-request queue timeout. Starting step 1 now.

infra-ops: Pushed circuit breaker config cb-21876 to prod:
```
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/api/cb -d '{"id":"cb-21876","tenant_filters":["tenant-A","tenant-C"],"max_concurrent":6}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
Applied, returning 200.

incident-bot: Update 11:22 UTC - circuit breakers active. Immediate tail 5xxs dropped ~55%. Telemetry: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ingress/queue-pressure?from=now-15m

omar: Enabled fallback routing rule for requests tagged low-priority -> us-west-cold. Expect ~25% traffic diversion.

li-wei: Patch to proxy timeouts applied: request_queue_timeout lowered from 12s -> 4s for streaming endpoints. Rolling restart of proxy pods in us-east1.

support-lead: External status note drafted and posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-21876/update - message: "Some Hosted API customers experienced elevated 502/504 errors in us-east1. Mitigations applied; most traffic restored. Remediation ongoing."

jessica: Autoscaler bumped ingress pool from 8 -> 24 nodes as precaution. CPU/queue metrics stabilizing.

omar: Confirmed root trigger: malformed chunked streaming requests (partner ingestion pipeline) causing cache misses and long-lived connections. Reached out to partner to throttle and correct chunking.

li-wei: Added short-term KV-cache aggressiveness tweak for long-sequence endpoints to improve cache hit probability. Will revert after postmortem if not needed.

tanya: Customers with SLA impact have been contacted; tickets created and owners assigned.

incident-bot: Update 11:47 UTC - service partial restore. Error rates back to baseline for majority of routes; continuing to monitor for 60m. Postmortem scheduled: RFC + blameless review at 2026-06-08 17:00 UTC. Placeholder: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/INC-2026-21876

jessica: Next actions: 1) complete blameless RCA 2) add automated detection for malformed chunking patterns 3) consider permanent per-tenant soft-limits + better client SDK guidance.

support-lead: Closing incident channel shortly; will re-open if regression. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
